name: gitblamesolo
description: Shows who changed the current line, when, and with which commit — inline and on hover.

gitBlameSolo.enabled.description: Show inline blame annotation for the current line.

gitBlameSolo.dateStyle.description: How dates are formatted in the inline annotation and hover.

gitBlameSolo.decorationTemplate.description: Template for the inline annotation. Placeholders: ${author} ${date} ${message} ${hash}

gitBlameSolo.decorationColor.description: Theme color id or hex color for the inline annotation. Empty uses editorCodeLens.foreground.

gitBlameSolo.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after cursor movement before recomputing blame.

gitBlameSolo.hover.enabled.description: Show full commit details on hover.

enumDescriptions: Show the hover only when the mouse is over the inline annotation at the end of the current line. Requires gitBlameSolo.enabled.
Show the hover when the mouse is anywhere over any line.
gitBlameSolo.hover.trigger.description: Where the mouse must be to show the blame hover.

gitBlameSolo.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this are skipped for performance.

gitBlameSolo.uncommittedLabel.description: Label shown for lines that have not been committed yet.

gitBlameSolo.currentUserLabel.description: Shown instead of the author's name in the inline annotation and status bar when the author's email matches your git user.email. Leave empty to always show the name.

gitBlameSolo.showAuthorEmail.description: Show the author's email next to their name in the hover. The inline annotation and status bar never show it; the commit details panel always does.

gitBlameSolo.statusBar.enabled.description: Show blame for the current line in the status bar. Clicking it opens the commit details.

gitBlameSolo.statusBar.template.description: Template for the status bar item. Placeholders: ${author} ${date} ${message} ${hash}

gitBlameSolo.ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace-only changes when finding the commit that last changed a line (git blame -w).

enumDescriptions: Attribute moved lines to the commit that moved them.
Follow lines moved or copied within the same file (git blame -M).
Also follow lines moved or copied from other files in the same commit (git blame -C). Slower on large repositories.
gitBlameSolo.detectMovedLines.description: Attribute moved or copied lines to the commit that originally wrote them.

gitBlameSolo.ignoreRevsFile.description: File at the repository root listing commits to skip in blame, such as bulk reformatting (git blame --ignore-revs-file). Ignored when the file doesn't exist. Leave empty to disable.

gitBlameSolo.exclude.description: Glob patterns for files that get no inline annotation, status bar entry, or hover, for example "**/*.min.js".
